recap.text: Anaconda is a level 75 quarter naga and lead dancer at the Penis Parade. Carl and Samantha climb hidden stairs to find him crying beside Damascus Steel while Vorpals take Minge. Anaconda declines another dancer's offer to fight because of family business. He and Damascus walk into back cubicles to follow their father.

beats.headline: Crying in the middle of a raid
beats.text: Level 75. Quarter naga. One of the lead dancers at the Penis Parade and one of Princess Donut's favourites, a preference she has shared with the audience. Carl and Samantha come up the hidden stairs from the floors below with the Vorpals still at work, and there he is beside Damascus Steel, crying too hard to stand up. The Vorpals take Minge in front of him. He does not look up for it.
beats.gist: Anaconda is a level 75 quarter naga and lead dancer at the Penis Parade.

beats.headline: Family business
beats.text: Another of the dancers offers to come along and fight. He declines, and the reason he gives is family business. Damascus hauls him up off the floor. He says that if his brother is going after their father then he is going too, and the pair of them walk into the back cubicles, where whatever happens happens off camera.
beats.gist: A dancer offers to fight, but he is declined due to family business.
